candidate.reason: V8_0_1 remains the latest stable release, so a distinct stable differential does not exist at execution time. The issue explicitly permits an exact current-upstream commit for questions not represented by the stable baseline.

hypotheses.claim: Distinct same-process STEP writers/work sessions do not provide a sufficient isolation boundary for conflicting writer tolerance state on the founding baseline; current upstream must be measured rather than presumed fixed.
hypotheses.falsification: Sequential controls serialize their requested uncertainties and the deliberately interleaved distinct-writer control also serializes each requested uncertainty on a tested version.

hypotheses.claim: Per-instance SetRunParallel remains job-local while BOPAlgo_Options global parallel mode remains process-global.
hypotheses.falsification: SetRunParallel mutates the process-global flag or conflicting threads no longer observe the shared global flag.

hypotheses.claim: The RCS-007 valid-but-materially-wrong fuzzy skim and order-sensitive finish chain remain decisive warnings unless the current candidate demonstrates materially correct outcomes under the same fixture.
hypotheses.falsification: The positive skim removes the analytic target within the declared material oracle and the 100-cut chain becomes order-independent within the existing oracle.

hypotheses.claim: The RCS-011 retrace-jitter one-shot freehand batch remains materially unsafe and dense sampled fallback remains pathologically expensive unless directly disproved.
hypotheses.falsification: Batch and segment reference volumes agree within 0.05 mm3 and the bounded sampled control completes inside 8 seconds under the same hosted-Linux envelope.

hypotheses.claim: BRepGraph history, UID and freshness facilities are useful backend-private derived-state aids but are not durable programme identity or canonical manufacturing provenance.
hypotheses.falsification: The facilities cannot represent one-to-many and many-to-one history or detect graph-generation staleness; no result can promote a graph-local UID to programme identity because that would contradict the canonical journal/provenance contract.

required_probes: sequential and interleaved distinct STEP writers
per-instance and process-global Boolean parallel controls
retrace-jitter segment reference versus one-shot batch
BRepGraph split, many-to-one merge, generation freshness and rebuild UID observation
protected_semantics: canonical operation journal remains durable manufacturing intent
BRepGraph and OCCT identifiers remain backend-private derived-state identities
process isolation remains required unless separately and broadly qualified
STEP remains mandatory primary engineering output
valid B-rep is not accepted as proof of materially correct machining
disconnected bodies, source semantics and provenance may not be silently dropped
